notes.title: Online Multiplayer
notes.notes:
Hey quite some time since greenlight

Most of the Prototype team members have finished their education at Games-Academy. Like I did. 
I started to rework the whole project so it's playable online and with full controller support. To achieve that i switched over to "Unreal Engine 4". The anew created prototype is running and already in a better condition than the old one. 

Also additional improvements [list]
[*]Menu Navigation
[*]Voice Selection
[*]More Feedback visual & audiovisual.
[*]Backport Ability to protect your Base
[/list]
 
[img]http://i.imgur.com/PH5wzkJ.png[/img]

WIP Video and Screenshots at the Unreal Engine Dev.Blog
 [url=https://forums.unrealengine.com/showthread.php?146822-Shiny-Ninjas-Online-Stealth-Brawler&highlight=shiny+ninjas] Unreal Dev.Blog [/url]
[url=https://twitter.com/nifty_games] Twitter [/url]


Any Feedback or Suggestion is welcome. 

Have a nice day :)
Nifty Productions
